title: How we can use light to see deep inside our bodies and brains | Mary Lou Jepsen
summary: Inventor Mary Lou Jepsen demonstrates using red light and sound to see inside the body and brain, aiming at tumor detection and neural activity measurement, and potentially a cheaper wearable MRI replacement.
why: HN mentions it as a reference for Openwater's approach of light-based deep tissue imaging.
